topic: The peacock mantis shrimp's record-breaking club strike
title: Mantis Shrimp: The 50 mph Punch That Cracks Glass
description:
The peacock mantis shrimp swings its club at about 23 meters per second underwater. See how it scores in our attack and defense ratings.

#mantisshrimp #animals #nature #shorts

scenes.narration: A shrimp the size of your hand throws the fastest punch in the animal kingdom.

visual.prompt: a vividly colored peacock mantis shrimp raising its club claw on a coral reef, macro shot, sharp light

scenes.narration: The peacock mantis shrimp whips its club forward at about 23 meters per second, roughly 50 miles per hour, and it does that underwater.

visual.prompt: a mantis shrimp claw striking forward underwater with a trail of bubbles, side view, high speed look

scenes.narration: The acceleration is over ten thousand times gravity, so fast that the water boils into tiny bubbles around the claw.

visual.prompt: tiny glowing bubbles collapsing in dark water near a shrimp claw, macro, dramatic light

scenes.narration: When those bubbles collapse, they create a second shockwave, so even a near miss can stun its prey.

visual.prompt: a ripple shockwave spreading through clear blue water around a small crab, close shot

scenes.narration: It smashes snail shells and crab armor, and large ones have been known to crack aquarium glass.

visual.prompt: a cracked snail shell and crab on sand next to a mantis shrimp burrow, underwater close up

scenes.narration: Attack score: ten out of ten. Defense score: only four, because it hides in a burrow and relies on its punch.

visual.prompt: a mantis shrimp peeking out of a rocky burrow on the seabed, eyes visible, soft light

scenes.narration: Would you bet on this tiny fighter against a crab? Comment your pick, and follow for more animal showdowns.

visual.prompt: a small crab facing a colorful shrimp on a reef floor, dramatic side light

motion.text: Would you bet on the shrimp?
